rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for a plan, explanation, or argument that is orderly and makes sense.

example.traditional: 呢個解釋講得好有條理。
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 gaai2 sik1 gong2 dak1 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5

rows.note: Use this especially when ideas, speech, or writing connect smoothly from one point to the next.

example.english: Your article is coherent from beginning to end.
example.traditional: 你篇文章由頭到尾都好連貫。
example.jyutping: nei5 pin1 man4 zoeng1 jau4 tau4 dou3 mei5 dou1 hou2 lin4 gun3

rows.note: Use this for parts, colours, or a design that harmonize or fit well together.

example.english: The colours in the living room are coherent.
example.jyutping: haak3 teng1 di1 ngaan4 sik1 hou2 hip3 tiu4

rows.note: Use this when separate elements form one unified whole, rather than merely being logical.

example.english: The format of this report is very unified, so the whole thing looks coherent.
example.traditional: 呢份報告嘅格式好統一，成份嘢睇落好有條理。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 bou3 gou3 ge3 gaak3 sik1 hou2 tung2 jat1 seng4 fan6 je5 tai2 lok6 hou2 jau5 tiu4 lei5
